title: Industrial Internet of Things-Industry Standard 4.0
description: This course explores smart production line technologies that constitute a smart factory. Students learn about Industry 4.0 architecture; Digitization and Smart Data; Smart Manufacturing Principles; Industry 4.0 Lean manufacturing; and the Internet of Things (IoT) as it applies to manufacturing.
outcomes: Identify relevant applications of Internet of Things(IoT) in Manufacturing.
Understand concept of the Fourth Industrial revolution and the importance of Smart Manufacturing
Understand Industry 4.0 architecture and the significance of Smart Data
Design a system, component, or process to meet desired needs within realistic constraints such as manufacturability, and sustainability, translate into high productivity
Use the techniques, skills, and modern engineering tools necessary for engineering practice, reducing development cycle time.
lab: Simulating Industry 4.0 architectures for various manufacturing applications.
Trouble shooting to determine Manufacturing efficiency
Configuring Green Manufacturing for Smart Factories
Configuring Manufacturing Execution Systems(MES) for Smart Factories
Configuring and Testing PLC and Bus Technology
Configuring and Troubleshooting Links to the ERP
Designing and Implementing a Product plan including parts purchase and supply
Designing and Implementing a Production plan
Designing and Implementing Marketing and sales for Smart Factories
Setting up a Materials and Inventory management systems for Smart Factories
Configuring Retail systems (Webshop order) for Smart Factories
Setting up Shipping, Payment, Billing systems
Configuring a system to Manage multiple factories
Configuring Autonomous Data Acquisition for ERP
assignments: Reading of selected course materials as suggested by the instructor.
Team-based projects to plan the process of manufacturing a component using
Program the Production line using Programmable Logic Controllers(PLCs).
Take home written assignments on Industry 4.0 concepts
